scope: Depth-ladder Head-directed support policy. Depth zero establishes the generated-design reward lineage from the exact search-admissible pool; deeper rungs use strict incumbent improvement. WT/native is never relabelled as a reward incumbent.

depth0_reward_bootstrap.candidate_domain: The exact endpoint pool remaining after the cycle's search-admission and sequence-equivalence representative selection.
depth0_reward_bootstrap.selection: Ascending (head_global_risk, endpoint_id); select rank zero only.
depth0_reward_bootstrap.required_proof: Cycle-minted binding of source state, depth zero, protein, selected endpoint id and content digest, and the complete ordered search-admissible candidate rows.
depth0_reward_bootstrap.fallback: none; a missing or mismatched rank-zero proof emits stall_missing_depth0_selection_proof
depth0_reward_bootstrap.commit_law: Only a committed D0 transition binds the selected donor as I1. A null, stalled or invalid transition creates no reward incumbent.

reference_roles.cumulative_safety_reference: Immutable WT/native complete sequence used by the cumulative safety admission ratchet at every depth.
reference_roles.depth0_attribution_reference: The same content-bound WT/native bytes used only for D0 aligned-window direction and leave-one-out revert residues; this role is not a reward incumbent.
reference_roles.lineage_reward_incumbent: Absent at D0; I1 is the committed D0 rank-zero donor; Id for d >= 1 is the last accepted exact feasible endpoint in the lineage.

deeper_donor_gate.epsilon_source: frozen Head repeatability or numerical precision calibration

write_law.candidate_domain: editable non-anchor positions unresolved in the live source, donor/attribution-reference-discordant at D0 or donor/incumbent-discordant at d >= 1, and covered by an aligned Head window improved in the donor
write_law.contribution: R_H(donor with position reverted to the active attribution comparator) - R_H(donor)
write_law.positive_gate: strictly greater than the calibrated local-contribution tolerance
write_law.selection: descending contribution, residue index as final deterministic tie-break

reopen_law.target: content-bound midpoint_tie_low centre of the exact schedule band

artifact_contract.required_fields: reward_gate_kind, nullable incumbent identity, nullable donor-gate epsilon, attribution-reference identity, and the nullable canonical D0 selection proof

not_authorized: WT-as-reward-incumbent at D0, a D0 epsilon comparison, endpoint_rank > 0 bootstrap, proof construction outside the real search-admissible cycle pool, incumbent advancement before commit, or weakening the strict D1+ margin.
